title:
A "typeof operator" represents examining an expression to determine its primitive type of whether it is an "object"
in JavaScript. It returns a string with one of the following values:
 - "string"
 - "number"
 - "boolean"
 - "function"
 - "object"

@see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Operators/typeof
name: Code.TypeOf
